extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, agents, and practitioners interacting with the Brazilian National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI)
extracted.subtask_description: Official list of INPI Directorate of Patents service codes and their procedural requirements (filings, deadlines, appeals, certificates, corrections, special examinations) for patents, utility models, certificates of addition, and related administrative acts in Brazil.

rubrics_metrics.name: 200 – National invention application; National utility model
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing of application of patent of invention, utility model patents, national application for certificate of addition and national certificates of inventions, as well as entry of the national phase of the PCT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers initial filings and national phase entry; code used for lodging new national invention or utility model applications and certificates of addition.

rubrics_metrics.name: 206 – Meeting of requirement arising from formal examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the meeting of a requirement arising from formal examination, as provided for in art. 21 of Law No. 9,279/96, considering the formal non-compliance with art. 19 of such law, but which includes sufficient data related to the object, the applicant, and the inventor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the formal requirement is not met within thirty (30) days, the application shall be deemed non-existent.

rubrics_metrics.name: 207 – Meeting of requirement in 1st instance
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to meeting of requirement, as provided for in art. 36 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requirements are not met within ninety (90) days, the application will be finally dismissed. For failure to meet requirements from order No. 1.5 of the admissibility examination for entry of PCT national phase, the period is sixty (60) days and the application shall be deemed withdrawn with respect to Brazil.

rubrics_metrics.name: 208 – Rehabilitation of an application, patent, utility model, and certificate of addition of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the rehabilitation of a proceeding dismissed as a result of failure to pay annual fees, as provided for in arts. 84 and 85 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rehabilitation must be requested within three (3) months pursuant to art. 87 of Law No. 9,279/96, under penalty of final dismissal or cancellation of the patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: 209 – Reopening of an application, patent, utility model, and certificate of addition of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the reopening of a proceeding dismissed as a result of the lack of request for a technical examination, as provided for in art. 33 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reopening must be requested within sixty (60) days pursuant to the sole paragraph of art. 33 of Law No. 9,279/96, under penalty of final dismissal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 210 – Submission of subsidies to technical examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the submission of subsidies to technical examination, as provided for in art. 31 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows submission of technical evidence/subsidies to assist INPI's technical examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 214 – Appeal of an invention patent, utility model, or certificate of addition of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the filing of an appeal, as provided for in arts. 212 to 215 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this service to file administrative appeals against INPI decisions within the statutory framework cited.

rubrics_metrics.name: 215 – Nullity or Expiration of an invention, utility model, or certificate of addition of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for an administrative proceeding of nullity by a lawfully interested third party, within six (6) months of the granting of a patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proceedings pursuant to arts. 46 to 55 of Law No. 9,279/96; time limit is six months from grant to request nullity.

rubrics_metrics.name: 216 – Contestation of the Owner with respect to Nullity
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the filing of a contestation by the owner of the patent, utility model, or certificate of addition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contestation must be filed within sixty (60) days of the publication of the notice of filing of administrative nullity, pursuant to art. 52 of Law No. 9,279/96.

rubrics_metrics.name: 218 – Offer of patent license for purposes of exploration or renovation of offer
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request or renewal of an offer for a patent license.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided for in arts. 64 to 67 of Law No. 9,279/96; used to record or renew offers to license patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 219 – Certificate of progress of the patent application with INPI and correspondence to patent granted abroad
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for a Certificate of progress of the patent application with INPI and its correspondence to the patent granted abroad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for purposes of partial meeting of the requirements provided for in art. 70.9 of the TRIPS Agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 248 – Change in name, corporate name, headquarters and/or address
rubrics_metrics.description: Service to inform data to be updated in the patent Database through an annex; for a national legal entity, annex shall include the contract amendment with former and new names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To change headquarters or address, a simple proof or simple declaration from the interested party is sufficient. A different GRU (payment form) will be generated for each request/patent to be changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 249 – Annotation of transfer of owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for annotation of transfer of owner through full or partial assignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proceedings pursuant to arts. 58, 59, and 60 of Law No. 9,279/96; use to record assignments and ownership changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 250 – Certificate of acts related to the proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for a certificate of acts related to the status of the proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document contains information on application, title, applicant, publications in the Industrial Property Journal (RPI), payments, filing or not of administrative nullity, existence of lawsuit, transfer of ownership, and annotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 251 – Certificate of search for owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the requirement of search for processes held by an individual or legal entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides bibliographic data and relevant RPI publications of applications, patents, utility models, or certificates of addition held by the owner.

rubrics_metrics.name: 252 – Issue of a duplicate for the letter patent or a certificate of addition of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for replacement of a letter patent or certificate of addition of invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when original documents are lost or need replacement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 253 – Official copy for purposes of claim of unionist priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request of an official copy for purposes of claim of unionist priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides authenticated copies required to claim unionist priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: 256 – Request for return of term due to disqualification of the interested party
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for return of term due to disqualification of the interested party, when caused by an unexpected event beyond the party’s will that prevented performance of the act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cause is defined per art. 221, paragraph 1, of Law No. 9,279/96 and art. 2 of Resolution No. 21/2013. The request must be made by petition during the effectiveness of the term provided by law or within five (5) days of cessation of cause; INPI will analyze the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: 257 – Request for return of term due to INPI’s fault
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for return of term due to fault or failure by INPI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request must be made during the effectiveness of the term; for cause, the INPI assistance delay must exceed five (5) days from the date of application for copy, pursuant to arts. 3 and 4 of Resolution No. 21/2013. Failure to request timely may result in estoppel.

rubrics_metrics.name: 258 – Relinquishment or waiver
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for relinquishment of an application or waiver of a patent, utility model, or certificate of addition of invention granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pursuant to art. 29 and art. 78, item II, of Law No. 9,279/96.

rubrics_metrics.name: 259 – Proof of payment of fees (including upon meeting of a requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the submission/proof of payment of required fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this service to present payment evidence, including when meeting an INPI requirement that mandates fee payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 260 – Other petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the petition of documents in general whenever there are no specific services provided for.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes submission of a power of attorney, unionist priority, statements, clarifications, and other general petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 261 – Restatement due to an error in the publication in the Industrial Property Journal (RPI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for correction of an error in a publication in the Industrial Property Journal (RPI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to request corrections to RPI publications that contain mistakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 263 – Priority Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for priority examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows applicants to request expedited examination on the basis of priority criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: 264 – Information on the authorization number for accessing the sample of national genetic heritage (Positive Access Statement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to information on the authorization number required to access a sample of national genetic heritage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the authorization number (Positive Access Statement) information needed for compliance with genetic heritage access rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 272 – Opinion on an expert report issued as an appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the opinion on an expert report issued as an appeal, as provided for in art. 213 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the expert opinion is not complied with within sixty (60) days, the appeal shall be decided upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: 273 – Negative access statement for the sample of national genetic heritage
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to issuance of a Negative Access Statement for a sample of national genetic heritage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used where access requirements for genetic material are not met, producing a negative access statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 275 – Submission of biological sequences listing pursuant to Resolution No. 81/2013
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the submission of biological sequences listing in the cases provided for in art. 7, paragraph 1, or art. 15 of Resolution No. 81/2013.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when disclosing biological sequence information as required by the cited resolution and articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 276 – Search and preliminary opinion on patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for search and preliminary opinion on patentability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: INPI performs a search and issues a preliminary patentability opinion upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: 277 – Collaborative Priority Examination (PPH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for a priority examination as a result of the PPH Pilot Project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables participation in the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot for accelerated examination based on partner office results.

rubrics_metrics.name: 279 – Strategic Priority Examination (green patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the request for a strategic priority examination of green patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expedited examination route for patents with environmental/green technology relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 280 – Meeting of requirement as an appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the meeting of requirement as provided for in art. 214 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the requirement as an appeal is not complied with within sixty (60) days, the appeal shall be decided upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: 281 – Opinion on invention, utility model, certificate of addition for the invention at first instance
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the opinion resulting from the Acknowledgement of the Opinion, as provided for in art. 36 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If non-compliance occurs, within ninety (90) days the previous technical opinion shall be maintained.

rubrics_metrics.name: 282 – Opinion on the summoning of parties as annulment (appeal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the opinion resulting from the summoning of parties as an appeal, as provided for in art. 53 of Law No. 9,279/96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If non-compliance occurs within sixty (60) days, the annulment shall be decided upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: 283 – Opinion on a preliminary opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Service related to the opinion on a preliminary opinion on patentability, as provided for in art. 15 of Resolution No. 123/2013.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a formal channel for INPI opinion generation on earlier preliminary patentability opinions.
